verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a REST API, custom integrations, and an MCP server that can query and update live workspace data. None of the evidence mentions a sandbox, test workspace, or other non-production environment for safe testing. A sandbox is a reasonable thing to expect from an API-exposed SaaS platform, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
